summary: Implement an Administrator login with a distinct layout from Parent/Child users, and an Admin Dashboard with user metrics, drill-down lists, login analytics by date range, and mobile/phone percentage reporting.

existing_features.title: Create a distinct Administrator login/access screen layout (separate from Parent/Child user flows) for the admin password gate step shown when an authenticated admin has not yet passed the gate.

Ensure all user-facing text added/changed for the Administrator login/access screen is sourced via the existing i18n system and has English strings (and pt-BR equivalents where the app already supports both).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a separate Administrator login flow with a new layout distinct from Parent/Child login
Admin Dashboard: show counts of Parent users and Child users; clicking each opens a list with user information
Admin Dashboard: show number of logins per day with configurable filter (specific date, month, or year)
Admin Dashboard: provide reporting on percentage related to users' cellphones (e.g., mobile usage/phone-related percentage)
